headline: Names a Post Office building in Oklahoma City after civil rights leader Clara Luper.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 305 Northwest 5th Street in Oklahoma City as the Clara Luper Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or who it serves. The official summary does not describe any other effects.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021.
